title: Certification and the required showing
summary: Certification is the court’s decision that a proposed group and its representatives satisfy the legal conditions for class treatment. It requires analysis of the applicable Rule 23 requirements, not simply acceptance of a class label.
notes: Wal-Mart requires rigorous analysis even where an issue overlaps the merits. Eisen does not prohibit all merits-related examination necessary for certification.

sections.Meaning: Certification is the court’s decision that a proposed group and its representatives satisfy the legal conditions for class treatment. It requires analysis of the applicable Rule 23 requirements, not simply acceptance of a class label.
sections.How to work through the question: Examine numerosity, commonality, typicality, and adequacy, then the requested Rule 23(b) category. Identify the evidence capable of proving the shared issues and whether certification can be decided without resolving unnecessary merits questions.
